items.title: Beyond Linux: A Journey Through the Open Source Ecosystem
How LinkedIn Built a View-Agnostic Analytics System for Modern iOS UI Architectures
items.blurb: To address the challenge posed by modern iOS UI systems where the logical UI structure may not mirror the native UIKit hierarchy, LinkedIn engineers developed a view-agnostic analytics system build around a shared MeasurableNode contract.
